hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$root/.pre-commit-config.yaml" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$root" && pre-commit run --files "$f" 2>&1); [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2
[ -f flake.nix ] && git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.nix$' && nix flake check 2>&1 | head -20 || true
